{{Top|leg}}
The '''Notron Centurions''' were an organization that likely dated back to the earliest era of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] history when the planet was named Notron. They wore helmets that would go on to inspire those of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]].
